turns.teacher: Good morning children. Sit properly, take out your notebooks. Today we are doing subtraction.
turns.label: other

turns.teacher: First sum on the board: fifty two minus twenty seven. Do it quickly in your notebook.
turns.label: new_sum

turns.teacher: Rabi, you wrote thirty five? No, no, that is wrong. Arjoon, next.
turns.label: move_on_or_scold

turns.teacher: Arjoon, you also got it wrong. The answer is twenty five. Everybody write twenty five and say it with me, twenty five.
turns.label: tell_answer

turns.teacher: Listen again. Two minus seven is not possible, so we borrow. I told you, we BORROW. Two minus seven is not possible, so borrow!
turns.label: repeat_same_way

turns.teacher: Thumbs up if you understood. Everyone? Okay, good.
turns.label: check_whole_class

turns.teacher: Now next sum. Forty three minus eighteen. Mina, you do it.
turns.label: new_sum

turns.teacher: Mina, twenty six is wrong. Don't count on fingers, it is not correct. The answer is twenty five. Write it.
turns.label: tell_answer

turns.teacher: Okay, time is over. Close your books and do the remaining sums at home. Stand up quietly for the next period.
turns.label: other
